name: The Determinate Nix Installer
description: Install Nix with the Determinate Nix Installer. See: https://github.com/DeterminateSystems/nix-installer

extra-args.description: Extra args to pass to the planner (prefer using structured `with:` arguments unless using a custom planner!)

extra-conf.description: Extra configuration lines for `/etc/nix/nix.conf` (includes `access-tokens` with `secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN` automatically if `github-token` is set)

flakehub.description: Automatically log in to your [FlakeHub](https://flakehub.com) account, for accessing private flakes.

force-docker-shim.description: Force the use of Docker as a process supervisor. This setting is automatically enabled when necessary.

github-token.description: A GitHub token for making authenticated requests (which have a higher rate-limit quota than unauthenticated requests)

github-server-url.description: The URL for the GitHub server, to use with the `github-token` token. Defaults to the current GitHub server, supporting GitHub Enterprise Server automatically. O

init.description: The init system to configure, requires `planner: linux-multi` (allowing the choice between `none` or `systemd`)

kvm.description: Automatically configure the GitHub Actions Runner for NixOS test supports, if the host supports it.

local-root.description: A local `nix-installer` binary root, overrides any settings which change the `nix-installer` used (binaries should be named `nix-installer-$ARCH-$OS`, eg. `nix-

log-directives.description: A list of Tracing directives, comma separated, `-`s replaced with `_` (eg. `nix_installer=trace`, see https://docs.rs/tracing-subscriber/latest/tracing_subscrib

logger.description: The logger to use for install (eg. `pretty`, `json`, `full`, `compact`)

ssl-cert-file.description: An SSL cert to use (if any), used for fetching Nix and sets `NIX_SSL_CERT_FILE` for Nix

proxy.description: The proxy to use (if any), valid proxy bases are `https://$URL`, `http://$URL` and `socks5://$URL`

mac-case-sensitive.description: Use a case sensitive volume (`planner: macos` only)

mac-encrypt.description: Force encryption on the volume (`planner: macos` only)

mac-root-disk.description: The root disk of the target (`planner: macos` only)

mac-volume-label.description: The label for the created APFS volume (`planner: macos` only)

modify-profile.description: Modify the user profile to automatically load nix

nix-build-user-base.description: The Nix build user base UID (ascending)

nix-build-user-count.description: Number of build users to create

nix-build-user-prefix.description: The Nix build user prefix (user numbers will be postfixed)

source-binary.description: Run a version of the nix-installer binary from somewhere already on disk. Conflicts with all other `source-*` options. Intended only for testing this Action.

source-branch.description: The branch of `nix-installer` to use (conflicts with `source-tag`, `source-revision`, `source-pr`)

source-pr.description: The PR of `nix-installer` to use (conflicts with `source-tag`, `source-revision`, `source-branch`)

source-revision.description: The revision of `nix-installer` to use (conflicts with `source-tag`, `source-branch`, `source-pr`)

source-tag.description: The tag of `nix-installer` to use (conflicts with `source-revision`, `source-branch`, `source-pr`)

source-url.description: A URL pointing to a `nix-installer` executable

reinstall.description: Force a reinstall if an existing installation is detected (consider backing up `/nix/store`)

start-daemon.description: If the daemon should be started, requires `planner: linux`

diagnostic-endpoint.description: Diagnostic endpoint url where the installer sends data to. To disable set this to an empty string.

trust-runner-user.description: Whether to make the runner user trusted by the Nix daemon

nix-installer-branch.description: (deprecated) The branch of `nix-installer` to use (conflicts with `nix-installer-tag`, `nix-installer-revision`, `nix-installer-pr`)

nix-installer-pr.description: (deprecated) The PR of `nix-installer` to use (conflicts with `nix-installer-tag`, `nix-installer-revision`, `nix-installer-branch`)

nix-installer-revision.description: (deprecated) The revision of `nix-installer` to use (conflicts with `nix-installer-tag`, `nix-installer-branch`, `nix-installer-pr`)

nix-installer-tag.description: (deprecated) The tag of `nix-installer` to use (conflicts with `nix-installer-revision`, `nix-installer-branch`, `nix-installer-pr`)

nix-installer-url.description: (deprecated) A URL pointing to a `nix-installer.sh` script

_internal-strict-mode.description: Whether to fail when any errors are thrown. Used only to test the Action; do not set this in your own workflows.
